title: Compose human Safety approval in the PWA

gates.name: safety_approval_browser
gates.command: cd frontend && npm run test:e2e -- tests/e2e/safety-approval.spec.ts

verify: Independent approval verification covers authorize approve/reject, permission/freshness/version/archive failures, exact request allowlist, authoritative reread, and no device effect.
evidence_required: FT-016-AC-026 RED: no browser human Safety approval consumer exists; GREEN: exact authorized approve/reject changes only the owning backend lifecycle while permission/freshness/version/archive cases fail without transition or device effect; decisive comparison: request allowlist, response/DOM, and authoritative decision/task reread; artifact: Safety-approval evidence under .tasks/TASK-104-T3-FT-016-W3/.
purpose: Expose human Safety approval as a completion independent of Task reads, completion, and Outcome recording.
success_outcome: An authorized current approver can submit the exact decision while denied, stale, expired, conflict, or archived requests leave Safety/Task state and devices unchanged.
anti_goals: Do not implement Task/Approval lists, Task completion, Outcome recording, expiry extension, or arbitrary Task creation.
Do not treat UI/governance state as Safety clearance or execute a device.

forbidden_scope: approval expiry extension or arbitrary action
stop_conditions: The user action is outside the exact human approval route.
The PWA would need to infer clearance/freshness or trigger a device.

constraints: Primary owner is Operator PWA; Safety Gate and Task & Follow-Up own clearance and lifecycle mutation.
Use exact registered decision fields and backend-derived current guards.
invariants: Physical action remains human-performed after fresh evidence, Safety pass, and authorized approval.
Consultant, denied, stale, expired, conflict, and archived approval attempts remain non-mutating.
verification_targets: FT-016-AC-026: exact human approve/reject plus permission/freshness/version/archive failures and authoritative reread.
T3 harm proof uses isolated decisions/tasks and confirms safe rerun/denial causes no transition or device effect.
